name: skrrt
description: Skrrt agent skills as installable Claude Code plugins — one plugin per bucket.

plugins.name: ship
plugins.description: Git shipping workflow: conventional commits with gitmojis, PRs and MRs opened and merged with the matching forge CLI, curated releases.

plugins.name: docs
plugins.description: Documentation authoring — structured markdown with YAML frontmatter, Mermaid diagrams, and auto-fixed lint-clean output.

plugins.name: dev
plugins.description: Implementation workflow: scoped subagents with a reviewing main thread, design principles, testing, research, plain reporting, and self-documenting code.

plugins.name: ui
plugins.description: One design skill on top of Emil Kowalski's and Apple's design skills: modern references, variants, and on-screen checks.

plugins.name: term
plugins.description: Terminal look and feel for Claude Code: a Catppuccin Mocha status line with model, git, context use, and rate limits.
